blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—University of Santo Tomas forward Mark Llemit showed out in the squad’s 81-69 win over Far Eastern University in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Wednesday. Aside from wanting to recover from the Growling Tigers’ overtime loss to National U, Llemit had another source of motivation sitting on the sidelines. Multi-time NBA champion Dwyane Wade was at courtside as part of his TADHANA: Make Your Own Way Manila Tour.
